from_notes: Devaluation of currency in 1966 ... Nationalisation of 14 banks in 1969; First Budget in Free India: R K Shanmugam Chetty -1947; In 1991, the government of India initiated [dismantling of Licence Raj]
from_notes_src: NextGen Indian Economy APPSC 01 (src/economy/nextgen-indian-economy-appsc-01.txt) p.12, 14; NextGen Indian Economy P1 04 p.25; NextGen Indian Economy P1 01 p.59
x: First Union Budget of independent India (26 Nov 1947, R.K. Shanmukham Chetty) → rupee devalued by about 57% (June 1966) → 14 banks nationalised (19 July 1969) → direct-tax-cutting Budget (read as V.P. Singh's 1985-86 Budget) → Licence Raj dismantled (1991). Options starting A, E or B, C put 1991 or 1969 out of order; only A, C, B, D, E keeps devaluation before nationalisation.
dispute: Printed key: A, C, B, D, E (D read as V.P. Singh's 1985-86 Budget). If D is taken as the 1997-98 'Dream Budget' (corporate and income-tax cuts), the strict order would be A, C, B, E, D, which is not offered.
source: NextGen Indian Economy APPSC 01 p.12, 14; NextGen Indian Economy P1 04 p.25-26 (1947 Chetty; 1997-98 Dream Budget); NextGen Indian Economy P1 01 p.59 (Licence Raj, 1991); the1991project.com/timeline/1966-devaluation (57%, June 1966); D = 1985-86 Budget: general knowledge, not checked (web search snippets only)

from_notes: New Rs. 500 and Rs. 2,000 notes were been issued on 8 November 2016. The old series of Rs. 1,000 and Rs. 500 notes were demonetized from midnight on 8 November 2016.
x: Demonetisation of the old ₹500 and ₹1,000 notes was announced by PM Narendra Modi on 8 November 2016 and took effect from that midnight, to curb black money and counterfeit notes and push digital payments. 2014-15 precede it; 2017 was the GST rollout year.
source: NextGen Indian Economy P1 01 (src/economy/nextgen-indian-economy-p1-appsc-01.txt) p.45; NextGen Indian Economy APPSC 05 p.3, 11

from_notes: Urban Infrastructure Development Fund (UIDF): A fund designed to support Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities in creating viable infrastructure projects, managed by the National Housing Bank.
x: Only III is valid: UIDF's eligible activities are aligned to the missions and programmes of MoHUA. It is funded from banks' Priority Sector Lending shortfall (not G-Sec bonds, so I is wrong), used by public/State agencies and ULBs (not private agencies, so II is wrong) and managed by the National Housing Bank (not municipal cooperative banks, so IV is wrong).
source: compass.rauias.com/current-affairs/urban-infrastructure-development-fund/ (PSL shortfall; NHB; public/State agencies, ULBs; activities aligned to MoHUA missions); Economic Survey 2025-26 Summary 02 p.63 (managed by NHB)

x: Patanjali Ayurved (Baba Ramdev) launched 'OrderMe', a swadeshi-only e-commerce platform, on a pilot basis on 15 May 2020, after the 'vocal for local' call. ITC, Reliance (JioMart) and Tata were not behind OrderMe.

from_notes: Rs. 200 Note: Colour: Bright Yellow; Release Date: 25th August 2017 ... Back – Image of the Sanchi Stupa
x: RBI issued the new ₹200 denomination (Mahatma Gandhi New Series, bright yellow, Sanchi Stupa motif) on 25 August 2017. There are no ₹150, ₹250 or ₹300 notes.
